title: Pin Down the Light
style: cinematic indie folk, post-rock, fingerpicked acoustic into wall of sound, 88 BPM, male baritone lead, female harmony, brushed snare into full kit, warm and hopeful
lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic, room sound, single soft cymbal swell]
(spoken, warm, male)
you can't catch a tunnel.
but you can name the light at the end.
and naming is enough.

[Verse 1 - male baritone, gentle]
i tried to hold the dark in my hands once
slipped through every finger like cold breath
the tunnel doesn't want to be possessed
the tunnel only wants to lead somewhere
so i stopped chasing it and i stood still
and i named the light at the far end patience
and the tunnel didn't argue
the tunnel just kept being a tunnel
and i kept being someone walking through

[Pre-Chorus - female harmony enters, brushed snare]
some things won't be held
some things will only be named
naming a thing makes it real enough
to walk toward without falling through

[Chorus - full kit enters, big strum, both voices]
pin down the light
not the road, not the room, not the night
pin down the light
that's all you're meant to do
the tunnel will move
the road will turn
the room will fill and the room will empty
but the light at the end stays steady
pin down the light

[Verse 2 - male, firmer]
i used to want to pin everything
the people, the future, the year ahead
turns out the things worth pinning are small
a name, a colour, a single thread
i pinned kind on the day i'm having
i pinned warm on the people i love
i pinned morning on the next thing coming
and the rest can be wide and loose enough

[Bridge - acoustic alone, female harmony only, spoken final line]
(spoken, soft)
not everything wants to be caught
some things only want to be witnessed
witness the light
that's the whole job

[Final Chorus - biggest, full band, both voices]
pin down the light
not the road, not the room, not the night
pin down the light
that's all you're meant to do
the tunnel will move
the road will turn
the room will fill and the room will empty
but the light at the end stays steady
pin down the light
pin down the light

[Outro - acoustic alone, fade]
name the light.
walk toward it.
that's enough.
